title: Dynegy Moss Landing Power Plant Hybrid: Phase 56F Coverage Decision
summary: CPUC confirms that its Vistra Moss Landing investigation remains ongoing and explains the audit-to-corrective-action process. Phase 56F decision: Current regulator status is closed as ongoing; root cause, complete corrective action, and operating restoration are not.
